scenes.text: Have you ever truly wondered what is actually hidden deep inside the Earth, far beneath the glowing red magma and solid rock that we all pictured in our childhood school science classes?

Scientists recently made a mind-blowing discovery of a colossal reservoir of water hidden four hundred miles beneath the Earth's crust, trapped inside a rare, sponge-like blue rock called ringwoodite.
This deep subterranean ocean is actually three times larger than all of the massive surface oceans combined, which completely changes how we think about where our water originally came from.
You are literally walking on top of a massive, secret alien ocean every single day of your life, so comment below if you would ever dare to travel down there!
